sentences.text: The reported activity probably correlates with a significant spike in appliance energy usage observed in the house during the night.
Between 00:10 and 00:30, the observed appliance energy was 90 Wh, which is much higher than the expected 40 Wh.
This energy usage was outside the expected range of 20 Wh to 54 Wh, suggesting that the machines were waking up or running unexpectedly.
It is likely that this deviation is simply due to normal equipment cycling rather than anything unusual.
